notes.form: Judgement priors, not fitted coefficients. Shrink sparse output toward a neutral 50; goalkeeper form needs ratings rather than goals. Fetch time is never a match date.
notes.absence: Replacement shares and ranges are assumptions, not confidence intervals. Explicit zero-minute records support with/without associations, not injury diagnoses or causal effects.
notes.congestion: Actual kickoff timestamps and explicitly supplied travel only. A club's europe flag and an international window are not evidence that anyone played.
notes.gate: Constants fixed before evaluation. RPS must improve by at least 0.002, hit rate must improve, and the upper paired block-bootstrap RPS delta must be below zero. Missing history yields null deltas, not a measured zero. A structural shadow result cannot authorize the untested live ML head.
